summary: Hyperscale Data filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a private placement to one institutional investor of up to $16,216,216.22 of 7.5% OID convertible notes for a $15,000,000 purchase price, structured as a $10M first note and $5M second note, accruing 8% (18% on default). Notes convert after NYSE approval at the greater of a $0.1025 floor or the lower of $0.30 and a 10% discount to five-day VWAP, capped at 47,176,715 shares absent stockholder approval. Maturity is February 2027, extendable to May 2027. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
